tools.name: compare_plans
tools.description: Rank certified Texas electricity plans for a zip by real twelve-month cost at a monthly kWh average. Returns verified_as_of with every number.

tools.name: compare_this_house
tools.description: Rank certified Texas electricity plans for a street address using a twelve-month usage profile for that meter. Prefer this over compare_plans when the user has an address. The profile is an estimate for the premise, not Smart Meter Texas interval reads. If the meter is found but has no usage history

tools.name: explain_plan
tools.description: The receipt for one plan at a zip and usage: monthly line items, credits earned or missed, gotchas. Identify the plan by id, slug, or name.

tools.name: check_territory
tools.description: Whether a zip is in the deregulated Texas market, and which TDU serves it.
